本日志自**2026-11-14**开始建档，完整保留此后登记的公开记录。建立前的站史未完整重建；首批六条为有存档出处的回溯记录，原网页更新日期仍未核实，不能据此判断它们的先后或“新近”程度。

Registry recording began on **2026-11-14**. This page retains the complete public registry from that point. Earlier website history has not been reconstructed in full. The six initial entries are documented retrospective records; their original website-update dates remain unverified, so their relative recency cannot be inferred.

## 如何读日期 | Reading the dates

- **网页更新 / Website update**：经核实的网页编辑日期；它不是发掘、公布或论文日期。 / A verified website-edit date, distinct from excavation, announcement or publication.
- **回溯登记 / Retrospective record**：本日志记录既有内容的日期，不能代替原网页更新日期。 / The date existing content was entered into this registry; it does not replace its original website-update date.
- **发现／调查、公开公布、发表／报道 / Discovery/investigation, announcement, publication/report**：分开列出，保留“仅年／仅月”等原始精度；未核实的日期明确保留为空。 / Listed separately, preserving year/month precision; unverified dates remain unknown.

有核实网页日期的记录按网页更新日期由新到旧排列；回溯登记单列，日期相同不表示学术重要性或排名高低。历史记录使用“既有”标签；只有经审核且网页新增日期已核实的记录使用“新收录／新添”。日志类别仅说明编辑动作，不改变正式收录、证据等级、学术判断或排名。

Records with verified website dates are ordered by website-update date, newest first. Retrospective records are listed separately; equal recording dates express no scholarly priority or rank. Historical records use “Existing” labels; only reviewed additions with verified website dates use “Added”. Categories describe editorial activity and do not alter formal membership, grades, conclusions or ranking.

## 本周摘要与变更类别 | Weekly summary and change categories

首页仅列出最近 7 个日历日（America/Vancouver，含当日）有核实网页日期的记录，按类别分组、组内由新到旧排序。包括新收录条目、新添文献／报道、研究更新、暂定排名调整和其他网站更新。此日志不补推过去未核实的网页日期；没有记录不能证明没有变化。排名调整须另有人工批准，记录本身没有修改排名的权限。

The homepage includes only verified website-dated records from the latest 7 calendar days (America/Vancouver, including today), grouped by category and newest first within each group: archive additions, references/reports, research updates, provisional ranking changes and other website changes. Earlier unverified website dates are not reconstructed. Missing records do not establish absence of changes. Ranking changes require separate human approval; logging an event never authorizes a ranking change.
